newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates Landwirtschaftliche AAA l-term.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates Landwirtschaftliche AAA l-term.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Wednesday it had assigned a short-term rating of A1 plus, a long-term rating of AAA, a legal rating of 1 and an Individual rating of A/B to Landwirtschaftliche Rentenbank.
IBCA said the bank was the central provider of credit to the agricultural sector and the food industry and mainly channels its funds through other banks.
Its lending is predominantly medium and long-term.
"Apart from lending at market rates, the bank provides loans at preferential rates under five special loan programmes subsidised out of its own profits," IBCA said in a statement.
"It also has a broader role promoting the interests of the agricultural sector," it added.
Landwirtschaftliche has no shareholders, but the Federal Republic of Germany acts as its liable public entity and is responsible for ensuring that it can meet its obligations at all times, IBCA said.
